verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's own docs thoroughly detail DLSS 4 features for the 5090 — Multi Frame Generation, Super Resolution, Ray Reconstruction, DLAA — and note the NVIDIA app can update 'hundreds of games' to use these features, giving both documentation and broad game-support claims. Community reviews corroborate the tech exists and works, though they raise caveats (input sampling limits, 'MFG marketing' skepticism) rather than outright disputing functionality; FSR (AMD's competing tech) isn't documented since this is an NVIDIA-specific feature set. Missing for 10: independent third-party verification of exact per-game DLSS support counts, and no mention of FSR compatibility.
